title: Fix admin lockout guard: check runtime provider usability, not just enabled flag
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG2-17 / D-001 (memorysmith-delta-audit-26-07-11-07-55-39)

## Problem
The admin self-lockout guard only checks `IsEnabled` provider rows, not whether the provider is actually configured and usable at runtime. An admin can be locked out by disabling all providers, but the guard won't catch this if a provider row is marked enabled but has no API key or endpoint configured.

## Severity
High

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/AdminController.cs`
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/AdminSettingsService.cs`

## Recommendation
Add runtime provider availability validation to the self-lockout guard. Check not just `IsEnabled` but whether the provider can actually be used (has API key, endpoint, etc.).

## Existing Coverage
Extension to TSK-0300 (exists in MemorySmith.Agent tasks).
